techniques.name: Animation canceling
steps: Training room: try roll-canceling, dismount-canceling and blocking on every skill to learn which are cancelable.
techniques.rhythm: Amya: EVERY CLASS CAN DO IT! - Blocking is the primary cancel; roll canceling interrupts full spells, dismounts, and creates movement otherwise impossible. Costs extra stamina.

techniques.name: Active blocking
steps: it can be BROKEN and stagger you
techniques.rhythm: Don't get "Block checked" - Being an active blocker prevents undesired skills landing on you.

techniques.name: Horse-whistle CC immunity
steps: Time the whistle on the enemy CC
you take damage but no CC
techniques.rhythm: bugs out with PIN/LOCK skills, so care

techniques.name: Walk into braced units
steps: Walk (don't sprint) into their minimal range
techniques.rhythm: brace damage scales with your speed towards them - For braced units like Forte, Halberds, Phalanx - niche: enemy hero outnumbered, unaware or afk.

techniques.name: Sidestep-cancel finisher
techniques.rhythm: Amya: used to smother combos - Releases the fourth segment of the Normal Attack directly after a Sidestep, skipping the wind-up of stages 1-3.

techniques.name: Phase-chase
steps: Sidestep left, right, or back through units
close the distance on a fleeing hero or exotic
techniques.rhythm: cuts through a blob instead of pathing around it - Requires the Frenzy of Rage node. Amya's own phrase: a phantom trait for chasing heroes/exotics through unit blobs.

gameplay.text: Use your shield to absorb incoming attacks and create openings for powerful spear thrusts, shattering enemy formations with the strength of Sparta!
stay Front-Lane and CC any heroes/units on cooldown, while being able to sidestep through units at any time to chase a hero or exotic units.

roleLabel: The Shield & Spear excels at both defensive maneuvers and aggressive counter-offensives.

positioning.intro: Where to be during a fight:

bullets.text: Front-lane, CC heroes and units on cooldown - use sidesteps to cut through units any time you need to chase a hero or exotic unit.
Sidestep to adjust positioning, raise your shield, and always face the enemy head-on.
Gauge the distance to the enemy and time your sidestep attack - it protects you while you strike.
Blunt DMG&Pen leads the bonus list ahead of raw STR/AGI - denetax.fr flips this to Blunt as the MAIN stat instead

bullets.lead: Crit Value is a weak stat here:
bullets.text: you already sit at 100% crit rate on your main dps spell (not named by Amya).

bullets.lead: Heracles' Throw and Heracles' Mounted Throw don't share a cooldown:
bullets.text: don't hold one back thinking it does - use them independently.

bullets.lead: Frenzy of Rage is a chase tool, not just a dodge:
bullets.text: it lets you sidestep straight through unit blobs instead of pathing around them.
every successful block feeds the Rage/Fury economy that powers Spartan Kick.
your guard blocks almost everything frontal - the one gap is the enemy's ultimate skill.

combos.name: Rage into Spartan Kick
steps: block hits (+40 rage) / shielded-state unit hits (+15 rage) / landed ability hits (+30 rage)
Fury threshold (2 stacks, 3 with Wrath of the God)
combos.note: The whole kit feeds one resource pool - block and poke units to charge the AoE knockback ultimate.

combos.name: Kick into a wall
steps: target collides with a wall or obstacle
combos.note: Wall-impact adds +1500 bonus damage on top of the knockback chain-damage to anyone else in the path.

steps: Aegis Retribution 2nd stage (Vow of the Hunt node)
combos.note: Opens a damage-taken window for a harder follow-up hit. [GAP: no source names which skill or class this window is meant to combo into.]
